shippedNote: Parallel system to the Bug Ledger. Migration 0063, featureApi.ts, feature.mjs CLI, FeatureRequestModal.tsx (Settings > Suggest a Feature), AdminFeaturesPage.tsx (Ops Deck Features tab) with flag-linking. Commit 1bf95d6.

title: Refresh button on Features tab
description: Manual refresh on the Ops Deck Features tab instead of needing a full page reload to see a newly submitted request.
shippedNote: reloadFleetData now returns a Promise so the button can await + spinner instead of requiring a full page reload. Commit 228c582.

title: Flight-themed 3D aerodynamic jetliner coachmark tooltip for expense logging
description: 3D aerodynamic jetliner with banking physics, navigation beacons, dual engine thrusters, haptics, long-press reactivation on + FAB, and Settings reset row.

title: Numberless Spotify-Wrapped-Style Story Infographic Card
description: Qualitative travel archetypes, squad member superlatives, dynamic trip rhythm insights, passport stamp seal, and Night/Light theme switcher.

title: Lightweight UI/UX polish pass: view transitions, content-visibility, reduced-motion, skeleton loader
description: Batch of low-cost, resource-light UI/UX enhancements: native View Transitions API crossfade on tab switches (App.tsx, feature-detected with no-op fallback), content-visibility:auto on member and expense list rows to skip offscreen paint work, a global prefers-reduced-motion catch-all covering animations not already individually guarded, a missing :active press state on the base .secondary-btn, and a reusable CSS-only shimmer .skeleton utility replacing the blank white flash in RequireAuth while the session loads. No new dependencies, no JS animation libraries.
shippedNote: Commit pending push. Files: src/App.tsx, src/index.css, src/components/RequireAuth.tsx, src/components/ExpenseList.tsx.

title: Pending invite badge on Members tab
description: Members tab now shows a 'Pending' badge next to a member's name when they haven't claimed their placeholder via the /join trip-code flow yet (member.linkedUserId is unset). No badge once they've joined -- the existing avatar-photo-vs-initials swap already signals that, this only flags the exception. No schema change, purely a render-layer check on the existing linkedUserId field.
shippedNote: Commit pending push. File: src/components/MembersGroupsTab.tsx, src/index.css (.member-badge-pending).

title: Swipe-to-edit/delete on Members tab + tap-to-refresh on trip dashboard
description: Members tab admin rows now support swipe-left-delete / swipe-right-edit via the same SwipeableRow component ExpenseList already uses, gated by the existing checkCanDeleteMember permission check; non-admin viewers get no extra listener overhead. Trip dashboard header gained a tap-to-refresh icon (calls the existing refreshActiveTripExpenses) instead of a pull gesture, since the dashboard already has two conflict-avoiding pull-down gesture systems (sheet-collapse drag, filter-chip pull-reveal) that a third gesture would fight.
shippedNote: Commit pending push. Files: src/components/MembersGroupsTab.tsx, src/App.tsx, src/index.css (.icon-spin).

title: Per-tab code splitting for Superadmin Ops Deck
description: The 8 Ops Deck admin sub-pages (Command Center, Flags, Analytics, Trips, Users, Audit, Features, Tools -- ~2.9k lines combined) were all bundled eagerly the moment any admin tab opened, even though only one renders at a time. Converted each to React.lazy + Suspense so opening one tab only downloads that tab's code.

title: Async image decoding across all avatars/receipts + accessibility label audit
description: Added decoding="async" to all 11 tags app-wide (member avatars, receipt photos in ExpenseForm/ExpenseReviewModal, UPI QR code) so image decode work stays off the main thread during scroll/interaction. Audited Members tab for missing aria-labels on icon-only controls -- found and fixed the members-required-notice dismiss button, which had only a bare '×' glyph and no accessible name.
shippedNote: Commit pending push. Files: src/components/ExpenseForm.tsx, ExpenseReviewModal.tsx, ExpenseList.tsx, MembersGroupsTab.tsx, TripsListScreen.tsx, TripStack.tsx, UpiPaymentModal.tsx.

title: Close/Reopen Trip lock
description: Trip admins can close a trip once everyone's settled up, via Settings -> This Trip. Closed trips block new expenses and new members (mirrors the existing superadmin frozen kill-switch's guard on addExpense) while leaving all existing data untouched and visible. Reopen restores normal editing. New trips.closed boolean column (migration 0069).
shippedNote: Migration 0069 applied to remote. Files: supabase/migrations/0069_add_trip_closed.sql, src/store/tripStore.ts, src/services/tripApi.ts, src/types/index.ts, src/types/database.ts, src/components/SettingsView.tsx.

title: Remind All settlement nudge
description: Batch 'Remind all' button above the settlements list (admin-only, 2+ outstanding debtors) fans out the same settlement_reminder push each row's individual Remind button already sends, one tap instead of clicking through every person. Server-side 24h-per-pair cooldown still applies to each, so it can't spam anyone.

title: Per-trip push notification mute
description: Any member can mute a trip in Settings -> This Trip, suppressing only the FCM push -- the in-app notifications panel row is still written, so muted activity stays visible if they open the app, it just stops pinging their phone. New trip_mutes table (migration 0070, RLS-scoped to the owning user); send-push Edge Function checks it before sending FCM and skips muted recipients.
shippedNote: Migration 0070 applied to remote, send-push Edge Function redeployed. Files: supabase/migrations/0070_add_trip_mutes.sql, supabase/functions/send-push/index.ts, src/store/tripStore.ts, src/services/tripApi.ts, src/types/database.ts, src/components/SettingsView.tsx.

title: Expenses restructured into Trip Summary + Itinerary Ledger with advanced filters and cross-linking
description: Split the single Expenses surface into a Trip Summary tab (settlement hero, who-owes-who, category/member/trend analytics) and a day-wise Itinerary Ledger tab (Day-N grouping off trip.startDate, Amazon/Myntra-style advanced filter drawer: category/payer/date/amount/location/relation). Analytics content also lives standalone under Settings. Category donut, member bars, and settlement chips/rows cross-link into the ledger pre-filtered instead of duplicating lists.

title: Right-edge swipe navigation between tabs
description: App-wide swipe-left/right gesture (useTabSwipe.ts) to move between Expenses/Ledger/Members/Settings tabs, WhatsApp-style, for one-handed navigation. Touch-only, skips elements that already own a horizontal gesture (SwipeableRow rows, map containers) via a data-no-tab-swipe escape hatch.

title: Settlement section simplified: plain-language sentences + at-a-glance balance chips
description: 'Suggested Settlements' renamed to 'Who owes who'; added an always-visible chip strip (avatar + signed colored amount per person with a live balance) above the itemized settle list; each transfer row now reads as a plain sentence ('You owe Priya') personalized to the viewer instead of an arrow notation; audit-trail toggle shortened to 'Why?' / 'Hide breakdown'.

title: Uber-style full-screen bottom sheet with auto-hiding header
description: TripContentSheet gained a third snap point (top:0, was capped at 20vh) reachable by continuing an upward swipe from the list's scroll-top or via the drag handle. When fully expanded the floating trip header slides out of view and the map sits fully behind the sheet, maximizing content area on demand.

title: Drag-tracked tab-swipe navigation
description: Replaced the jump-cut tab switch with real finger-tracked swipe navigation between Expenses, Ledger, Members, and Settings tabs -- the incoming/outgoing pane visually follows the drag instead of only reacting on release.
shippedNote: src/utils/useTabSwipe.ts rewritten to expose activePaneStyle/previewTab/previewPaneStyle driven by live drag position instead of a binary swipe-then-snap.

title: Uber-style bottom sheet motion polish
description: Content sheet gained velocity-based fling snapping, a map-dim scrim proportional to drag progress, corner-radius flattening on reaching full-screen, a native haptic tick on snap, and status-bar icon color synced to whatever's behind it. Haptics/status-bar no-op on web.
shippedNote: src/components/TripContentSheet.tsx (velocity fling, scrim, corner-radius, haptics), src/utils/nativeShell.ts + src/App.tsx (status-bar tone sync). Added @capacitor/haptics + @capacitor/status-bar, npx cap sync run for Android/iOS.

title: Simplified who-owes-who summary card
description: BoardingPassHeroCard trimmed to drop its auto-generated restating sentence; settlement transfer list collapsed by default; per-transfer actions moved behind a compact more-actions overflow (Change amount / Remind / Share) with the audit breakdown reachable via a small info icon instead of a text link.

title: Analytics moved to Summary; geo map split into its own Settings section
description: Retired the standalone Analytics screen under Settings. KPI cards + category donut now live directly on the Summary tab (member/trend charts behind a disclosure); the geotagged expense route map (TripJourneyMap) is now its own dedicated 'Trip Map' section in Settings, decoupled from the stats.

title: 10 UI/UX enhancements: skeleton loaders, pull-to-refresh, edit-undo, settlement confetti + progress, duplicate expense, split preview, empty-state CTAs, category icons, command-palette hint
description: Batch of UI/UX polish across the app: swipe-row short labels (plain prop) on ExpenseList; command palette one-time nudge dot; live equal-mode split preview in ExpenseForm; widened category emoji picker; CTA buttons on empty members/groups states; dark-mode token audit (no issues found); settlement confetti burst + percent-settled progress bar in BalancesSettlements/UpiPaymentModal; duplicate-expense action in ExpenseReviewModal; pull-to-refresh on TripsListScreen and ExpenseList via new usePullToRefresh hook; skeleton loading states for app boot and per-trip expense fetch (expensesLoadingTripId in tripStore); optimistic expense-edit undo toast in UndoToasts/App.tsx.
